answer: Sponsors are capped at 4 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 60 POA until the newcomer survives 15 clean epochs, and a farm of 300 fakes must find 300 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. A spiral that can be verified, a voyage that can be measured, and a ridge that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
